text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"several body paragraphs with examples from a friend, the writer, and a teacher","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully an essay expands its ideas with supporting examples and explanation rather than staying at the level of brief claims."},{"evidence":"clear opening, multiple body paragraphs, and a concluding paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how well the writing is structured into recognizable parts that guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"“I have a friend...”; “I was not a timid girl...”; “I have a teacher...”","quality":"personal example use","description":"This captures the use of specific lived examples to make points concrete and more persuasive."},{"evidence":"“After he start to take the class...”; “Now I see how my friend is so happy and calm...”","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures the ability to extend an idea by adding consequences, reactions, and outcomes instead of only stating them once."},{"evidence":"“It helps me to forget all the problems that cause me stress”; “They were kind with me”","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"This captures writing that communicates intended meaning more directly and is easier for the reader to follow."},{"evidence":"“music, a drama, or an art class”; “creative part that they have inside”","quality":"word choice","description":"This captures somewhat more precise and varied vocabulary for discussing the topic and its effects."}]}
